title: Design Handoff v2
description: Schema v2: adds changes_pre_created (consumed by guide-plan intake). v1 readers must accept v1 payloads as-is (changes_pre_created defaults to empty array).

design_complete_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when design-done was completed

all_proposals_have_decision.description: True if every entry in proposal-suggestions.md has a decision

version.description: Schema version (must be 2 — v1 is legacy and rejected)

changes_pre_created.description: Names of changes created during design approve (consumed by guide-plan intake to skip recreation)
